_instructions: Each case defines the current frame state and what the user says.
The system must extract exactly the slots listed in expected_extractions.
description     : what is being tested (one sentence)
task            : dialog task description (the one the DialogManager receives)
slot_schema     : slot schema (same format as frame_schema_json in production)
frame_filled    : values already filled before this turn (simulates mid-conversation)
expected_extractions: list of {slot, value} expected to be extracted
For list_str: value is a list of strings
For a correction: include the new value
notes           : optional observations (what makes this case hard)
Guidance for annotating with an LLM:
Suggested prompt: 'Given this slot schema {slot_schema} and this frame state {frame_filled},
the user says: "{user_text}". Which slots and values should the system extract?
Return JSON with expected_extractions.' Then review manually.
